description: Returns traces matching given filter (Supported on Erigon).

sub_parameters.name: fromBlock
sub_parameters.description: The Quantity or Tag from this block

sub_parameters.name: toBlock
sub_parameters.description: The Quantity or Tag to this block

sub_parameters.name: fromAddress
sub_parameters.description: An array addresses of the senders

sub_parameters.name: toAddress
sub_parameters.description: An array addresses of the receivers

sub_parameters.name: count
sub_parameters.description: The integer number of traces to display in a batch

array.description: The block traces, which have the following fields (please note that all return types are hexadecimal representations of their data type unless otherwise stated):

array.action.description: The ParityTrace object, which has the following fields:

array.action.action.description: The action to be performed on the receiver id:

array.action.action.callType.description: The type of method such as call, delegatecall

array.action.action.gas.description: The gas provided by the sender, encoded as hexadecimal

array.action.action.input.description: The data sent along with the transaction

array.action.action.value.description: The integer of the value sent with this transaction, encoded as hexadecimal

array.action.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this transaction was in

array.action.blockNumber.description: The block number where this transaction was in

array.action.result.description: The integer of the gas price used encoded as hexadecimal

array.action.result.gasUsed.description: The amount of gas used by this specific transaction alone

array.action.result.output.description: The value returned by the contract call, and it only contains the actual value sent by the RETURN method. If the RETURN method was not executed, the output is empty bytes

array.action.subtraces.description: The traces of contract calls made by the transaction

array.action.traceAddress.description: The list of addresses where the call executed, the address of the parents and the order of the current sub call

array.action.type.description: The value of the method such as call or create
